meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 容器镜像会装上 mnemon,Claude Code 在每次回应前自动调出相关历史记忆,每轮结束后再写入新要点。记忆存在该 agent 组的 .claude/ 目录里,重启容器后仍然保留。
howto.when: 当你把该技能应用到运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent 组时使用;若组的 provider 设为 opencode 等其他值,hooks 不会运行。想给 agent 加上跨会话的持久记忆时也用它。

say.text: 给这个 agent 组装上 mnemon,让它记住之前的对话。
重启后 agent 不记得之前的对话了,帮我排查 mnemon。
say.note: 检查 MNEMON_DATA_DIR 是否指向挂载路径

say.text: 把某个 agent 的 mnemon 记忆全部重置掉。
say.note: 停容器后删除宿主路径下的 mnemon/ 目录

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon into the agent container image. Claude Code hooks recall past memory before each response and store new insights after every turn; memory lives in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount and survives restarts.
howto.when_en: Use it on agent groups running the default Claude provider; mnemon hooks only fire under --target claude-code. Groups set to another provider, such as opencode, never run the hooks.

say_en.text: Install mnemon on this agent group so it remembers earlier conversations.
say_en.note: Edit the Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuild the image

say_en.text: The agent forgot earlier turns after a restart — help me debug mnemon.
say_en.note: Check that MNEMON_DATA_DIR points to a mounted path

say_en.text: Reset all mnemon memory for one agent.
say_en.note: Stop the container, then delete mnemon/ on the host path
